purpose: Additive current-source questions for the unmerged verified Art storage integration; existing frozen question sets are unchanged.

questions.query: When does Art export verify its closed output, and can I still cancel before replacing the destination?
facts: The unmerged candidate verifies closed staging length and SHA-256 cooperatively before native atomic replacement.
Stop and Cancel remain effective during verification; refusal does not publish that export and source aliases are checked again at commit.
This is not a power-loss or fsync guarantee.

questions.query: Do verified Art preference saves rewrite unchanged settings or lose the previous cache after a failed write?
facts: The existing unchanged-settings cache avoids rewriting the committed configuration.
A failed write preserves the previous file and cache; only verified success updates the cache.
Successful retry or reversion clears only the save-owned error, with the profile size and admission guards preserved.

questions.query: Does verifying a private pending Art history receipt restore old conversations or change native Undo authority?
facts: Receipt identity and order advance only after complete closed-byte verification and publication.
The retained private writer does not activate old-journal restoration in ordinary session-only Art.
Native history and Architecture execution retain their existing owners; Windows and physical acceptance require distinct evidence.
